# ufoo 4.0.1

This release improves the shared agent runtime, internal-agent dashboard and
local performance observations, while removing abandoned execution paths.

## Agent runtime and observation

- Add offline `ufoo trace` and `ufoo metrics` queries, read-only MCP tools,
  configuration fingerprints and saved-baseline comparisons.
- Observe execution outcomes separately from delegated-task acceptance, with
  model/tool timing, usage coverage, retries, repeated calls, report lengths,
  queue state and compaction observations.
- Display token-weighted cache hit rates and fix Responses API parsing of
  `input_tokens_details.cached_tokens`. Missing cache fields remain unknown.
- Share execution budgets and durable checkpoint-based conversation compression
  between the main agent and native ucode; preserve transcripts and tool evidence.
- Improve response-language consistency, concise handoffs and acknowledgement-loop
  prevention across main and internal agents.

## Dashboard and providers

- Improve internal-agent live output, shared-input targeting, window focus and
  recovery, including grouped session recovery and native ucode resume.
- Support copying transcript text and align wrapped message lines with the
  speaker name in the main and internal-agent panes.
- Delete completed command-menu keywords with one Backspace; support
  Option/Alt + Backspace word deletion in main and internal-agent input.
- Refresh Codex and Claude SDK integration, model/thinking settings, custom
  endpoint handling and native credential isolation.
- Remove unused router, external dashboard-terminal and legacy renderer code;
  retain CLI wrappers and MCP cooperation for external agents.

## Validation

- JavaScript: 2,794 tests across 246 suites.
- Rust TUI: 72 tests and a local release build.
- Production dependency audit: no reported vulnerabilities.
- Isolated model-transport/file/shell checks validate observation and baseline
  export without calling paid model endpoints.
